purpose: Re-evaluate the adopted three-seed Task 3 decision under a scoring convention that is neutral to the assignment arbitrariness measured in experiment 79.
scope: Only test/03_task3_single_trial/80_multiseed_under_assignment_noise. Models are reloaded read-only from experiment 75 artifacts.

protocol.models: experiment 75 cached checkpoints, arms base (seed 42) and seed3 (42/202/777)
protocol.scoring: recompute the production Task 3 score (mlp + encoding + softmax-DCT, equal row-z) from src.final helpers, then verify the base arm reproduces the recorded heldout OCF 16.759832 within 1e-6
protocol.noise_neutral_ocf: average official OCF over 6 per-row positive weight draws U(0.6, 1.6), the SAME draws applied to both arms so the comparison is paired

pass_rule.retain_decision: mean paired difference (seed3 minus base) over the 6 draws is at least +0.30 AND positive in at least 6 of 8 mouse x session blocks
pass_rule.otherwise: the earlier +0.70 is judged not separable from assignment noise and the Task 3 multi-seed adoption is withdrawn
